svg.aria-label: What the record does not say: record coverage across 1000 merged pull requests and 64 directory areas
svg.text: 1,000 merged pull requests, scored question by question
explain none of their own mechanism
a model reading only the diff explains 54% of it

g.text: share of the mechanism the record explains
the darkest square is exactly zero — its own bin, not a low value

svg.text: One square is one merged pull request. All three panels below hold the same 1,000 changes,
each sorted by its own score — so the shapes are distributions, and only the record being read changes.

the subject line is not the record
250 merged pull requests — a separate draw — each scored twice
of explanation live in the body, not the title
so a repository that squashes to its title is unmeasurable, not merely worse
and it is not one number
the same measurement, per project in the corpus
Projects differ in how much agent-written work they carry, which is most of this spread.
where the record can be measured at all
24 large open-source repositories, by the share of their last 200 commits carrying a body
the two rules on every bar: 25% for a full estimate, 10% below which no map is drawn
3 repositories, 2,871 mechanism questions asked of their commits
One cell is one directory area, sorted low to high within its repository. Hatched cells were sampled too thinly to read. "+N" is areas that exist but were outside the sampling budget.
where the gap is — and where it closes
1000 records by length, against the model's account of the same change
the model, from the diff alone
length vs coverage: r = 0.66 over all 1000
r = 0.49 among the 711 substantive alone, so it is not only that empty records are short
at 900-1,700 characters the two medians are the same: 67% and 67% over 143 records.
Where an explanation exists, it does the job.
Longer records also describe bigger changes, and the model gets worse as changes grow.
64 directory areas, 2,931 questions asked of their commits
vertical position is spread to avoid overlap and means nothing

svg.text: Questions are generated from the diff alone; a second model scores the written record against them and never sees the code.
A tripped separation guard aborts the run rather than warning. Explicit means the record answers the question outright, not that a reader could infer it.
This measures what the record says, not what will break. Whether coverage forecasts a directory’s future was tested on 223 areas across four repositories: it does not, in either direction.
Source: study/results/three-arm-scores.csv, unit-mismatch-scores.csv, and the record map JSON. Every number here is computed from those files at render time.
